full_page.content:
1945, September 2
The following is a faithful transcription of the handwritten original by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.F.M.Cap.
225 Jerome St. Brooklyn.
September 2nd 1945
V. Brother Leo, O.F.M.Cap. St. Bonaventures, Detroit, Michigan
Dear Brother Leo:
God bless you and yours.
Many, many thanks for your helping in the good work in office these last few years, and again for your sending me those things - package after package - since I came East. We had our Retreat this year -- last two weeks -- in the Immaculate Conception Monastery. Thanks be to God it was ideal weather and the location could hardly be surpased. Brother Bonaventure and all send best wishes. Tell Br. Rufin
.
. my shins etc. are really doing fine; bother me
very little. Thank God . . Am trying to keep my conscience at least as good as the same old shins .
Fr. Solanus, O.F.M.C.
Note: Above message written on a picture postcard of the Shrine of Our Lady of Lourdes, Altadena, California with notation above picture:
"P.S. The most beautiful grotto I've ever visited. Note the natural water-fall below her feet."
